title: Night Trains from Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **You can sleep your way out of Berlin in six directions**: Paris, Brussels and Amsterdam, Zurich and Basel, Vienna, Budapest, and Stockholm. All facts checked on 1 September 2026.
**Two sleepers run every single night** from Berlin Hbf: the train to Vienna and Budapest around **20:11**, and the Nightjet to Basel and Zurich at **20:48**.
**Paris and Brussels/Amsterdam are European Sleeper trains from Berlin Gesundbrunnen, not Hbf**: Paris departs 17:25 on Mon/Wed/Fri, Brussels and Amsterdam 23:01 on Tue/Thu/Sun.
**Stockholm has two options**: the fast RDC EuroNight (18:39, Mon and Fri, arrives 09:45) and the cheaper Snälltåget (21:09, most nights, arrives 13:17 via Copenhagen).
**Book 2 to 3 months ahead.** Nightjet and EuroNight fares open about 6 months out, seats from about EUR 30, couchettes from about EUR 59. The Deutschlandticket is not valid on any night train.
**Do not take the sleeper to Prague**: it passes Prague around half past midnight. Use a day EC train for Prague and save the night train for Vienna or Budapest.
